meta.description: Convert Foot (ft) to Nautical Mile (nmi) instantly. 1 ft = 0.00016457883 nmi. Free, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Convert feet (ft) to nautical miles (nmi) instantly. Both measure length, so the relationship is strictly linear: each foot equals 0.00016457883 nautical miles. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One foot is equal to **0.00016457883 nautical miles**. To go the other way, one nautical mile equals **6076.115 feet**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> nautical miles = feet × 0.00016457883

Worked example — converting 10 feet:

10 × 0.00016457883 = **0.0016457883 nmi**.

To invert, divide by 0.00016457883 (or multiply by 6076.115).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 ft ≈ 0.00016457883 nmi. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Foot and Nautical Mile both measure length; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many nautical miles are in 1 foot?
**A:** 0.00016457883 nautical miles.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert ft to nmi?
**A:** nautical miles = feet × 0.00016457883.

**Q:** How do I convert nmi back to ft?
**A:** Multiply by 6076.115 (or divide by 0.00016457883).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this ft to nmi converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
